n = int(input())
s = input()

total_underscores = 0
max_segment = 0
last_index = -1
inside_parentheses = False

for i, ch in enumerate(s):
    if ch == '_':
        if last_index != i - 1:
            if inside_parentheses:
                total_underscores += 1
            else:
                max_segment = max(max_segment, i - 1 - last_index)
        last_index = i
    elif ch == '(':
        inside_parentheses = True
        if last_index != i - 1:
            max_segment = max(max_segment, i - 1 - last_index)
        last_index = i
    elif ch == ')':
        inside_parentheses = False
        if last_index != i - 1:
            total_underscores += 1
        last_index = i

if last_index != len(s) - 1:
    max_segment = max(max_segment, len(s) - 1 - last_index)

print(f"{max_segment} {total_underscores}")
